newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SKorean LG-Caltex to test new desulphuriser in Nov.
newsitem.headline: SKorean LG-Caltex to test new desulphuriser in Nov.

text.p: South Korea's LG-Caltex Oil Corp said on Thursday it plans to test-run its new 70,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) diesel desulphuriser in early November.
"We'll start test-running the desulphuriser early next month," LG-Caltex spokesman told Reuters by telephone. "But we're not sure when the unit will go commercial."
Construction of the new unit has just been completed and the company is conducting system checks, he said.
The desulphuriser will bring the refiner's diesel desulphurising capacity to 120,000 bpd, the spokesman said.
LG-Caltex, formerly known as Honam Oil Refining Co, is a joint venture between LG Group and Caltex Petroleum Corp, itself a joint venture between U.S. oil giants Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
It has a licensed refining capacity of 380,000 bpd.
